An '''X-wing pilot''' was a [[Tarsunt]] [[pilot]] for the [[New Republic]]. Around [[9 ABY]], their squadron was deployed to the isolated [[planet]] [[At Attin]] in order to repel a [[Invasion of At Attin|pirate invasion]] of this forsaken world.

==Biography==
A [[Tarsunt]] individual joined the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps]]<ref name="SC 108" /> at some point by [[9 ABY]].<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> During that [[time]], a group of [[youngling]]s<ref name="SC 101">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref> known as the [[Skeleton Crew]]<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> accidentally departed from their home [[planet]] of [[At Attin]] on an interplanetary journey.<ref name="SC 101" /> The children allied themselves with former [[pirate]] [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood]], with whom they travelled to the [[Observatory Moon]] to seek help from the [[Gender|female]] [[astronomer]] [[Kh'ymm]]. The woman discovered that At Attin was one of the [[Jewels of the Old Republic]], or a forsaken world accommodating an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] [[mint]], and helped pinpoint the coordinates<ref name="SC 103">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> that ultimately allowed the Skeleton Crew to return to their home planet.<ref name="SC 107">{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}}</ref> The [[Mission to the Observatory Moon]] ended abruptly when Kh'ymm summoned a [[New Republic]] squadron, fearing for the safety of Na Nawood's young companions. The squadron, however, failed to stop the Skeleton Crew's escape<ref name="SC 103" /> aboard the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]''<ref name="SC 105" /> for fear of posing a threat to the lives of the young crewmembers.<ref name="SC 103" /> The younglings and Na Nawood ultimately split their ways,<ref name="SC 105">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}}</ref> with Na Nawood—also known by his pirate name "Silvo"—regaining the command of his former [[Silvo's pirates|crew]].<ref name="SC 107" /> By posing as a Galactic Republic emissary, Silvo managed to destroy "[[the Supervisor]]," a [[droid]] responsible for overseeing the [[Great Work]] of credit minting on At Attin, and ordered his crew to launch a [[Invasion of At Attin|planetary invasion]]. Cooperating with their [[parent]]s, the Skeleton Crew younglings managed to bypass the [[Barrier]] that isolated At Attin and contact Kh'ymm, who—in turn—alerted the New Republic to inform them of the pirate invasion of the forsaken planet. Soon after, [[Undersecretary]] [[Fara]] disabled the Barrier altogether from the [[Supervisor's Tower]], leading to a series explosions rippling across the sky as the green Barrier burned away.<ref name="SC 108" />

[[File:XWingAttack-SC8.png|thumb|right|250px|The X-wings strafe the pirate frigate]]
Fara's deed allowed the New Republic [[squadron]] to reach the planet's surface. A total of eight [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s, of which one was operated by the Tarsunt, descended from [[Realspace|space]], backed up by two [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter|B-wings]]. [[Commander]] [[Kent]] ordered the squadron to lock their [[S-foils]] in attack positions, and other pilots provided their respondes. As [[Cail-tan]] set their [[deflector shield]]s double forward, the Tarsunt said, "Here we go," before the X-wings strafed [[Silvo's pirate frigate]]<ref name="SC 108" /> with [[laser]] fire.<ref name="SC 108 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> As the rounded-up At Attin citizens cheered down on the surface, the pirates started to retreat on their [[pirate dropship]]s, only to be attacked by the X-wings in the [[Atmosphere|air]]. Finally, the B-wings carved up through the upper side of the pirate frigate. As the bombarded ship drifted out of control and rested in a local [[water]] canal, two X-wings were patrolling by before flying off into the night. With the pirate invasion repelled, a New Republic [[CR90 corvette]] descended on the planet.<ref name="SC 108" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Color|dark]]-skinned member of the Tarsunt [[species]], the X-wing pilot sported a [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] adorned with a decal on the right side. The individual also wore a dark [[Hair|beard]].<ref name="SC 108" />

==Behind the scenes==
This pilot was portrayed by [[Andrea Detwiler]] in "[[The Real Good Guys]],"<ref name="SC 108" /> the eighth episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[January 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref> This character's name is not spoken in the episode, but they were listed in the credits as "Tarsunt X-wing pilot".<ref name="SC 108" />
